name: red-velvet-rose-perfume
image_purpose: Valentine's Day perfume advertisement and campaign key visual

prompt.project_info: Create a high-end Valentine's Day perfume campaign combining a red satin gown, burgundy roses, and a luxury fragrance still life.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features and wind-swept dark hair wears an elegant long red satin gown and holds a bouquet of deep burgundy roses. The flowing fabric creates a dramatic silhouette against a minimal ivory studio background.
prompt.composition_elements: Hero fashion composition with the woman and bouquet in the main frame; include a generic crystal perfume bottle on a red velvet pedestal in a complementary product still-life area, surrounded by rose petals, small gold heart charms, and soft pink mist.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: High-fashion lighting with a dramatic spotlight on the bottle and gown, glossy satin reflections, rich red and gold palette, soft pink atmospheric mist, romantic luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Luxury editorial photography, 1080x1080 square campaign composition, realistic satin, roses, crystal glass, velvet, petals, and mist, sharp product and fabric detail, no brand logo or rendered text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end Valentine's Day perfume advertisement and fashion editorial of an adult fictional woman with original non-celebrity features and wind-swept dark hair, wearing an elegant long red satin gown and holding a bouquet of deep burgundy roses. Minimal ivory studio background, flowing satin fabric, complementary product still-life with a generic crystal perfume bottle on a red velvet pedestal, scattered rose petals, small gold heart charms, soft pink mist around the bottle, dramatic spotlight, glossy reflective surfaces, rich red and gold palette, romantic luxury magazine aesthetic, 1080x1080 square composition.
